svg.text: Groups are points per line; "real" is the 1000 real-world lines, median 82 points. Between rounds a cell moved by a median of 29% to 35%, so bars closer than that are a tie.
Not drawn, to keep the scale readable: polyline-encoded (0.14x to 0.34x), @lp-labs/polyline-codec (0.04x to 0.13x), decode-google-map-polyline (0.01x to 0.09x).
Also not drawn: polytini's web and wasm entries and google.maps.geometry.encoding in Chrome. All of them are in docs/results.md.
